description: This source file defines the class 'ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler', which extends a base handler and implements logic for associating encounters with existing patient visits in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for retrieving a display name and for assigning an encounter to an appropriate existing visit based on encounter date and location.

classes.name: ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for assigning encounters to existing patient visits only, without creating new visits.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a localized display name for the handler indicating its purpose of assigning to existing visits only.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter
methods.description: Assigns an encounter to an existing visit if found, based on encounter date and location, and only if the encounter is not already associated with a visit.
